linh: Heads-up: planning a base-image rebuild + KMS rotation next Tue 02:00 UTC. Main risk = HSM policy preventing direct cosign->KMS. Proposing ephemeral signing helper as fallback. Need RBAC, webhook checks, audit routing, and rollback runbook. cc @omar @divya
omar: Agree on helper. Minimal privileges: helper SA allowed only kms:Sign on single key version, and only from signed-subnet via VPC condition. Builders get NO KMS perms.
divya: Audit: helper and cosign must emit structured JSON logs with fields: op, key_version, signer, pod_uid, image_digest. Route to splunk index "images-audit" and to long-term audit store (365d prod, 90d staging).
ben: RBAC plan: two roles - base-builder (push/pull, no secrets/kms) and image-signer (mount secret token for helper, call kms:Sign). Add OPA webhook to deny RoleBindings that grant base-builder the signer clusterrole.
linh: Example OPA policy (pseudo):
```
package deny
violation[msg] {
  input.binding.role == "image-signer"
  input.binding.subject.name == "base-builder"
  msg = "builders cannot be granted signer privileges"
}
```
omar: KMS note: prefer key versions + explicit promotion path. If rotation fails, revert to previous key version and revalidate signatures. Keep older key versions enabled for rollback window (48h).
divya: CI checks: add an integration job that after rebuild signs with helper and runs `cosign verify` across a canary cluster. If verify fails, auto-fail the pipeline and page oncall.
ci-bot: ci: staged-run 789 queued: sbom-scan -> sign-with-helper -> cosign-verify
ben: Registry retention: mark fallback tags immutable for 72h and keep last 40 signed tags per base to avoid GC.
l679: kms-bot: preflight: found missing iam-condition on key -> recommend: bind signer SA with condition `request.time < timestamp("2026-06-01T03:00:00Z")` and source.vpc == "proj-signed-vpc"
divya: Good. Need to ensure KMS audit logs include callerEmail so we can tie back to pod. Helper must add pod_uid and signer principal as annotations when calling KMS.
omar: Rollback playbook (short): 1) Pause rebuilds and deployments. 2) Re-enable previous key version. 3) Re-run cosign verify job across clusters. 4) If verification green, resume. 5) If not, escalate to security-incident and keep images pinned.
linh: Owner: I'm primary for the window; @omar backup. I'll open PR with RBAC, OPA webhook, and helper manifest. Please review within 24h.
ben: Quick ask: can helper be scheduled with nodeAffinity to isolated pool? reduces blast radius.
divya: Yes, schedule to dedicated signing nodes with taints + tolerations. Helper pod must be short-lived (TTL 1h) and require annotated SA: `audited=true`
ci-bot: ci: staged-run 789 started
linh: I'll post the invite and link PRs. Tag me if you see any blockers. :thumbsup:
